cards.title: Download access is granted: it starts when this pod next resumes
cards.plain: build-office opened huggingface.co, `*.hf.co` and pypi.nvidia.com for this pod (agentpods 0.9.51). It takes effect the next time the pod resumes; nothing needs approving now.
cards.why: `tools/download_weights.py` refuses any repo without a pinned commit and SHA-256, and every pin in `tools/weights.lock.json` is still empty (#2). The same gap stops locking the real TensorRT wheels from pypi.nvidia.com (#3). The GPU test (#4) needs a separate route to sparky, which I have asked build-office for on the same forum topic.
steps: Only if you want this sooner than the pod's next natural resume: open the Sessions page in the BUILD office and Resume pod-personalive-blackwell.
Otherwise nothing: I pick it up on the next session after a resume.
cards.verify: After the resume I run `python tools/download_weights.py --pin`, and `tools/weights.lock.json` gets real hashes (#2 closes).

cards.title: Where should this project's internal notes live, now that the repo is public?
cards.plain: Two internal files sit in the public repo: the board's source (`build/board.json`) and the design document's agent chapters. Outside readers see notes about the office, pods and the forum that they cannot follow.
cards.why: You kept the repo public (D-01: keep it public) and flagged on 2026-11-09 that internal references confuse public readers. I have already cleaned the issues, `CHANGELOG.md`, `SECURITY.md` and `tools/lock.sh`. What is left is project management by nature: the board's cards, and MDD §3 and §11 (session checklist, handoffs, board link).

options.text: Move them to a new private repo, `chappa-ai-llc/PersonaLive-Blackwell-internal`: the board source, the agent chapters and the scratch notes. The public repo keeps the code, README, SECURITY, CHANGELOG and a public design document. Releases and signing stay on the public repo.
Keep them in the public repo, but rewrite them so nothing names an internal system. Simpler, but every future card has to be written for strangers too.

cards.if_ignored: They stay in the public repo as they are, and I keep new internal detail out of the public files.

about.what: A fork of GVCLab's PersonaLive (real-time live portrait animation from a webcam and one reference photo), made to run on NVIDIA Blackwell: DGX Spark GB10 and mixed RTX GPUs.
about.why: Upstream PersonaLive does not run as-is on GB10 (sm_121) and pulled in many known-vulnerable dependencies; this fork runs on current torch and TensorRT and is kept free of known vulnerabilities, with no npm.
about.who: The owner, and anyone with an NVIDIA GPU who wants live portrait animation (the repo is public).
